data.name: Anymaker
data.detailed_description:
Build to Survive

Embark on your creative journey of vehicle design, as you create and operate vehicles to navigate this dangerous open world.

Engineer Anything

Anymaker is a detailed and technical vehicle building game. Design your chassis, build your engine, connect components and cables, program controllers, and test performance.

Fortify

The only safe places are those you make. Build your bases in mountains, towns, forests, or shores in this massive open world of wilderness stretching in every direction.

Scavenge food, clothes, equipment, building parts, weapons, and other items essential to your survival.

The weather, the wildlife, the undead, the remaining military forces are yours to evade and engage.

Discover the Truth

Looking for answers, your journey will lead underground to vast government complexes and the reasons for the end of the world.

Features

  • Vehicle and structures, grid based building system.

  • Massive open world featuring mountains, plains, forests, towns, industrial complexes, and more.

  • Wildlife, undead, and military forces.

  • Sprawling underground military and research facilities.

  • Day-night cycle.

  • Weather simulation including wind, rain, fog, temperature, and lightning storms.

  • Unlocks and progression system.

  • Cooperative multiplayer support for all game features including building.

  • In game voice chat and radio communication.

  • Character customization.

  • Hundreds of items, and inventory system.

  • Melee weapons and firearms, ammunition and attachments systems.

  • Microcontroller programming using drag-and-drop editor or text editing.

  • Input support for either keyboard & mouse or gamepad.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 470, NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 / 1060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11600 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 6600XT, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060
  • DirectX: Version 12
